title: •Scout Recon
caption: •Scout Recon (V)
game_text: Find one of your missing characters. OR During battle, activate 1 Force for each of your scouts participating. OR During battle, if your Imperial with opponent’s alien, your total battle destiny is +3.
lore: Familiarity with native terrain is essential to a scout garrison. Imperial command can also put this type of information to effective use.
